content.answer: Validate exit codes with `isinstance(code, int) and not isinstance(code, bool)`, so True/False (bool subclasses int) are rejected and only genuine ints (e.g., 0-255) pass.
content.reuse_advice: When validating any numeric field where bool is not acceptable, always exclude bool explicitly: `type(x) is int` or `isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool)`, since bool is a subclass of int in Python.
